responsibility: Classifies one exchange as question, addition, correction or explicit redirection using a closed vocabulary over the user's exact words.
reads: the verbatim instruction passed to it
failure_boundary: fail_closed toward continuity — an instruction with no explicit redirection marker is never classified as a redirection, so ambiguity preserves the active objective instead of replacing it
recovery_behavior: Pure function of its input with no state, so it returns the identical classification on any retry after any failure
replacement_contract: A replacement must keep redirection explicit, treat questions and memory fragments as retrieval cues, and return a rationale and matched marker alongside the classification
evidence_produced: is_retrieval_cue and is_fragment flags per exchange
